requirement: Update an antibiotic group: when a parent ID is supplied it must exist and must not be soft-deleted, the target group must exist, then map the new name, description, and parent onto the tracked entity, save it, and report Updated.

preconditions.text: A live antibiotic group exists for the target ID
The requested parent ID matches a live group
The requested parent ID matches no live group
The target ID matches no live group

inputs.text: Root group renamed to 'Aminoglycosides' with a new description and a null parent
Root group renamed to 'Glycopeptides' with a new description and a null parent
Standalone group reparented under an existing root group
Update request with an unknown group ID
Update request with an unknown parent ID
Update request with a soft-deleted parent ID

returns.text: Success with Updated status; name, description, and parent are persisted
UpdatedAt is refreshed on every successful update
Failure with BadRequest and the 'parent ID not found' error; target untouched
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Antibiotic group not found' error

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
